## XGBOOST RESULTS


```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

results = pd.read_csv("forecast_ppa_2026.csv")

top = (results.sort_values("pred_ppa_2026", ascending=False)  
         .head(25)
         .round(3)
         .reset_index(drop=True))
top.index += 1  

Markdown(top.to_markdown()) 
```
